articles.title: Here's how one decentralized cloud provider says private citizens can make money from AI
articles.snippet: Titan Network says its crowdsourced computing network has signed tech giants like Tencent and Alibaba as clients, saving them as much 75% on AI costs.

articles.title: Hyperliquid is beating ethereum in trading volume on some days as big money rotates, says FalconX
articles.snippet: Institutional investors are ditching range-bound bitcoin and ether for Hyperliquid as the decentralized platform wins over hedge funds with massive liquidity and early access to hot markets, according to Joshua Lim, head of markets at FalconX.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Stellar (XLM) falls 8.4%, leading index lower
articles.snippet: Aave (AAVE), down 3.9% from Monday, was also an underperformer.

articles.title: Live markets: bitcoin loses $67,000 level in Tuesday plunge, putting February's lows back in play
articles.snippet: Google overnight set an $80 billion capital raise, including $10 billion from Berkshire Hathaway, reflecting the continuing flood of money headed into AI (and not crypto).

articles.title: Bitcoin drops toward $69,000 as Saylor sale spooks investors while AI tokens buck the trend
articles.snippet: The price of bitcoin fell to its lowest since April 7 as Strategy's sale dented sentiment, while AI tokens H and NEAR surged and DeFi TVL hit a 20-month low.
